picks.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
picks.why_it_matters: A $7B+ exit for an AI infrastructure startup signals massive acquirer appetite for the 'picks and shovels' layer of AI, validating the AI gateway/routing category as a fundable thesis.

picks.title: Nvidia dramatically reduces amount of OpenAI infra financing it may guarantee
picks.why_it_matters: Nvidia pulling back on infrastructure financing could tighten compute access for frontier labs, creating opportunities for startups building efficient inference, model optimization, or alternative compute solutions.

picks.title: The AI Credit Resale Economy
picks.why_it_matters: An emerging secondary market for AI compute credits suggests infrastructure commoditization is accelerating, opening potential startup opportunities in brokerage, arbitrage, and cost optimization tooling.
